permissions.name: extensions.packages.revoke
permissions.note: Requires extensions.packages.read; resolve every dependent policy and adapter target before/after revocation, and require policy.policies.update over affected policy targets. Freeze id/version, dependency closure and generations. Preserve tombstones and fence grants, mounts, callbacks and queued work. Removing revocation requires extensions.trust.update; publisher-key revocation retains its immediate path.
